supportBacklog.label: Shared frame atlas variants
supportBacklog.missingRoleStatement: Current primitives do not provide a single reusable frame variant set for all required support panel sizes and state labels.
supportBacklog.trigger: At least two additive screenshot sets show unresolved frame-role mismatch after current-asset composition.
supportBacklog.blockedUntil: Wave 0 additive screenshot proof and missing-role approval
supportBacklog.notes: Shared support family scoped by P1-02; excludes plaque/ribbon/title-plate roles reserved for P1-02A.

supportBacklog.label: Plaque / ribbon / title-plate family
supportBacklog.missingRoleStatement: Current bars and blocks do not cover a reusable cross-screen title and badge carrier role with consistent hierarchy.
supportBacklog.trigger: Missing-role proof from additive screenshot sets on target screens (Wave 0 slots) confirms reusable header/title carrier gaps.
supportBacklog.deliverableType: reusable plaque and ribbon support parts
supportBacklog.blockedUntil: Wave 0 proof and explicit missing-role approval
supportBacklog.notes: Shared plaque/ribbon/title family only; dedicated world/building labels are deferred to P1-02B and state stamps/swashes are deferred to the later state-family packet.

supportBacklog.label: World / building label plaques
supportBacklog.missingRoleStatement: World and routed building surfaces lack a reusable diegetic label carrier role that preserves city and room scenic ownership.
supportBacklog.trigger: Additive World screenshots prove missing diegetic label roles for buildings, district grouping, current-city identity, and arrival context.
supportBacklog.notes: World label family only. City map and overlays remain preserved. Distinct from generic plaque family (P1-02A). State stamps/swashes are deferred. Live World integration is deferred to later implementation packets.

supportBacklog.label: Overlay / mask pack
supportBacklog.missingRoleStatement: Current shell layers lack reusable compositing masks needed to apply legibility emphasis consistently across multiple surfaces.
supportBacklog.trigger: Additive compositions across multiple screens still show unresolved compositing role after preserve-enhance usage.
supportBacklog.deliverableType: reusable alpha overlay and mask parts
supportBacklog.notes: Cannot be used to hide unresolved layout or truth-surface issues.

supportBacklog.label: State ornament family (P1-03A)
supportBacklog.missingRoleStatement: Current shared assets do not provide one compact reusable state-ornament vocabulary for tracked, claim-ready, recommended-now, caution, completion, and selected/current states while preserving chip-first semantics.
supportBacklog.trigger: Shared shell and overlay foundations are stable and Wave 0/Phase 1 captures still show missing compact state-support roles after preserve-enhance composition.
supportBacklog.deliverableType: shared state ornament support kit (stamps/swashes/underplates/underlays/chip companion)
supportBacklog.blockedUntil: Wave 0 state readability proof and no-layout-shift compliance review
supportBacklog.notes: Standalone P1-03A sibling packet to P1-03 overlays/masks. Support-role semantics only; no scenic replacement, no chrome ownership transfer, and no live screen integration in this packet.

supportBacklog.label: Shared FX sprite atlas
supportBacklog.missingRoleStatement: Current assets lack one reusable painterly low-frequency FX vocabulary (mist/dust/glint/ember/halo/seal/aura/firefly/brush shimmer) that remains coherent across quality tiers and Reduced Motion.
supportBacklog.trigger: Shared shell stability is confirmed and Wave 0 screenshot proof shows missing atmospheric support roles that cannot be solved by preserve-enhance composition alone.
supportBacklog.deliverableType: shared reusable FX sprite atlas vocabulary (docs/spec first, atlas-ready family examples)
supportBacklog.blockedUntil: Wave 0 screenshot proof of missing atmospheric roles and shared shell stability confirmation
supportBacklog.notes: Shared vocabulary only; support atmosphere only; no scenic replacement. Separate from P1-03 overlays/masks and separate from later hero enhancement kits. No live screen integration is authorized in this packet.

supportBacklog.label: Cultivation hero enhancement overlays
supportBacklog.missingRoleStatement: Current center stack lacks reusable additive emphasis layers for hero focus while preserving existing cultivator and dantian semantic owners.
supportBacklog.trigger: Blocked until P1-05 trigger pack conditions are all met: exact-screen screenshot proof, shared chrome/overlays/fx approved, and a screenshot-backed missing support role remains.
supportBacklog.blockedUntil: Wave 1 and Wave 2 completion with explicit owner-preservation proof
supportBacklog.notes: Later-wave support-only family. Blocked spec until all trigger evidence passes; no live integration or cleanup authority.

supportBacklog.label: Heart Law altar / seal support kit
supportBacklog.missingRoleStatement: Current Heart Law compositions lack a reusable sacred-focus support kit that can frame altar/seal states without replacing doctrine shells.
supportBacklog.trigger: Blocked until P1-05 trigger pack conditions are all met: exact-screen screenshot proof, shared chrome/overlays/fx approved, and a screenshot-backed missing support role remains.
supportBacklog.blockedUntil: Wave 1 support completion and approved role-gap evidence
supportBacklog.notes: Later-wave support-only family. Blocked spec until all trigger evidence passes; no live integration or cleanup authority.

supportBacklog.label: Optional medallions / icon seals
supportBacklog.missingRoleStatement: After functional support roles are complete, optional reusable ornament seals may still be missing for non-critical ceremonial accents.
supportBacklog.trigger: Only evaluated after core support backlog closure and explicit non-critical ornament gap confirmation.
supportBacklog.blockedUntil: All core support families resolved and not blocked
supportBacklog.notes: Never a prerequisite for Phase 1 support-art progress.

phase1Scaffold.notes: Scaffold metadata only; does not alter preserve/enhance/create-later semantics.
